$schema.description: Editor hint only; ignored by the loader.

id.description: Unique merchant id, e.g. "briar-glen-general-store". Stable once shipped.

notes.description: Who runs it and why these prices and stock, for owner review.

npcId.description: The NPC who speaks for the shop (dialogue speaker id).

displayName.description: The keeper’s name as the shop window shows it, e.g. "Ottilie Marsh"; absent = the NPC id made readable.

shopName.description: The shop’s name, e.g. "Brand’s Forge" (signage, shop window subtitle).

personalityTags.description: Personality traits that colour barks and haggling.

specialties.description: Item categories bought at a better rate (`specialtyBonus`); must be bought categories.

buysCategories.description: Item categories the merchant buys from the player.

lootTable.description: A loot table rolled to stock the shelf (a shop that varies).

count.description: Units of the item, or rolls of the loot table.

restock.description: How the stock refills; absent = never restocks.

amount.description: Units (or rolls) added each time, up to `count`.

goldReserve.description: Gold the merchant starts with to pay the player for sales.

goldRestockPerDay.description: Gold the reserve refills by each in-world day, up to `goldReserve`.

markup.description: Multiplier on item value when the player buys (economy band 1.1-1.5).

buyRate.description: Fraction of item value paid when the player sells (band 0.3-0.6).

specialtyBonus.description: Extra multiplier on the buy rate for specialties (band 1.1-1.3); default 1.2.

isFence.description: A fence deals in stolen goods.

buysStolen.description: Buys stolen goods; only a fence (`isFence`) may.

stolenFactor.description: Multiplier on the price of stolen goods (band 0.5-0.8); default 0.6.

hours.description: Opening hours (world-time hook); absent = always open.

open.description: Hour of day (0-23) the shop opens.

close.description: Hour of day (0-23) it closes; may be earlier than open (overnight).

barkSet.description: Bark set id for the shopkeeper’s lines (E22).
